card.name: Immunoglobulin after pooled intramuscular/intravenous
card.fires_on: The word just before 'immunoglobulin' in exposure-prophylaxis text, mainly ' immun' (the start of immunoglobulin) after 'pooled intramuscular' or 'pooled intravenous', and 'avenous' in 'intravenous'.

modes.label: Start of immunoglobulin
modes.description: The piece 'immun' that begins 'immunoglobulin' after pooled intramuscular or intravenous.
modes.example: prophylaxis with pooled intramuscular<< immun>>oglobulin (IG) may be indicated

modes.label: End of intravenous
modes.description: The last piece of 'intravenous' just before 'immunoglobulin' in an IVIG phrase.
modes.example: therapy with variicella zoster immune globulin (VZIG) or pooled intr<<avenous>> immunoglobulin (IVIG), as

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with immunoglobulin-type words such as immun, glob, Ig and album.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name an immunoglobulin product given after an infection exposure.
